label: Brown butter
note: Unlike ghee and clarified butter, the browned milk solids stay in the butter.

about.text: Butter melted and heated until the milk solids that sink to the bottom turn a deep, toasty hazelnut brown, which gives it a nutty smell and flavour. Used in French pastry (madeleines, financiers) and over fish, pasta and vegetables.
